title: Enterprise managed settings enforcement updates
factSummary: Enterprise administrators can require supported Copilot clients to retrieve current managed settings at startup. With this requirement enabled, a client stops if it cannot confirm current policy; this is not the default for every user.

title: Code scanning AI Scan metrics in security overview
factSummary: GitHub added AI Scan metrics showing findings, resolutions and trends to security overview. This is a public preview for eligible GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security customers on github.com, not all deployments.
